tests.name: Tree — indented variant (#2476)

whenUse: Hierarchical data where every item has one parent — a file system, an org chart, a category hierarchy — as collapsible depth-indented rows beside a detail panel.
whenNot: Arbitrary many-to-many edges — use GraphCanvas or NetworkPage. A flat list — use CollectionPage.
